title: SBRG v2: Relax one boundary equality (score = degree/radius) + enlarged trust-region, equality-SLSQP
abstract: Second, single SBRG attempt. Choose the boundary equality to relax by maximizing interior degree divided by radius (prioritizes highly connected, small discs). Enforce all other boundary equalities at tol=1e-8, apply a larger trust region, and run equality-constrained SLSQP from SOTA_243. Return the better of candidate vs baseline with 1e-9 shrink; log diagnostics.
